full_prompt_en: This is a tall-framed black-and-white photographic portrait presented within a square case image, showing an older man in round dark glasses and a layered suit against a plain dark backdrop. He is centered from the chest upward, facing the camera almost directly with a calm, slightly questioning expression. Curly gray hair spreads irregularly around the top of his head, catching pale light along individual strands. The glasses make two small dark circles around his eyes, while the nose and closed mouth remain softly but clearly modeled. A dark textured jacket, V-neck knit layer, shirt, and patterned tie stack down the lower part of the frame, giving the portrait a neat vertical structure. The jacket shoulders approach both side edges, and the cropped chest prevents any wider setting from appearing. The background is an even charcoal gray that darkens near the left side of the figure, making the face and hair the brightest parts of the image. Soft studio light from above and slightly to the right illuminates the forehead, cheek, and hair; gentle shadows under the brow, chin, and clothing folds preserve depth without harsh contrast. Fine photographic grain is visible in the midtones, particularly on the jacket and background. The tie pattern and knit texture add small rhythms beneath the smoother skin. No objects or readable text compete with the figure. The overall composition is reserved and direct, relying on a steady gaze, compact formal clothing, and delicate monochrome transitions.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅置于方形案例图中的竖向黑白摄影肖像，一名戴深色圆框眼镜的年长男子穿层叠西装，身后是素净深色背景。他从胸部以上居中出现，几乎正面朝向镜头，神情平静，略带疑问。卷曲灰发不规则地散在头顶，单根发丝沿边缘接到浅色光。眼镜在双眼周围形成两个小小的深色圆环，鼻子和闭合的嘴则柔和而清楚地塑形。深色有肌理的夹克、V领针织层、衬衫和花纹领带沿画面下部层层排列，使肖像具有整齐竖向结构。夹克肩部接近两侧边缘，被裁切的胸部不让更宽的场景进入。背景是均匀的炭灰，在人物左侧附近更暗，使面部和头发成为最亮的部分。柔软影棚光从上方略偏右处照到额头、脸颊和头发；眉下、下巴下与衣褶里的轻柔阴影保留纵深，却没有严酷反差。中间调可见细微摄影颗粒，尤其在夹克和背景上。领带花纹与针织肌理在较平顺的皮肤下方增添细小节奏。没有物件或可读文字与人物争夺注意力。整体构图克制而直接，依靠稳定的目光、紧凑正式的衣着与精细单色过渡。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photographic style is restrained, with softly modeled midtones and a plain dark field. Fine grain gives smooth areas a physical finish, while small repeated textures gather in lower, denser passages. Gentle high-side light lifts central planes and catches irregular fine edges; shallow shadows under projecting forms supply volume without theatrical darkness. Circular accents and a stable vertical axis organize the close crop. The brightest values remain compact, surrounded by charcoal and black fabric-like areas. Edges are clear at the focus but never brittle, and the background stays deliberately quiet. The overall effect is thoughtful, intimate, and formal, with modest tonal variation carrying most of the character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色摄影风格克制，以柔和塑造的中间调和素净深色画域构成。细颗粒赋予平滑区域物理质感，细小重复肌理则聚集在下方更密的部分。来自上侧的温和光抬亮中央平面，并触及不规则的细边；凸出形状下的浅影提供体积，却不形成夸张黑暗。圆形强调与稳定竖轴组织近距离裁切。最亮明度保持紧凑，周围是炭灰和织物般的黑色区域。焦点边缘清楚却不脆硬，背景有意保持安静。整体效果沉思、亲密而正式，由适度的明度变化承载主要性格。
theme_en: A bespectacled older man in a dark suit against a plain backdrop
theme_zh: 一位戴眼镜的年长男子身穿深色西装，立于素净背景前
name: Woody Allen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
